requests.problem: Private WinForms/COM handlers lack a safe injected seam for direct event-source lifetime tests without control activation.
requests.proposal: Review an internal Windows-only event/connector ownership seam with Attach/Detach/Rebind/Observe and borrowed-object policy. Keep public Core/Common API and existing behavior. Regression comparisons and source review before production work.
requests.acceptance: Direct fake-host tests cover actual RefEdit handler orchestration, duplicate/failed detach, stale callback/rebind/disposal and zero output on invalid lease. Then narrowly approved native regression. Current observer tests are not that proof.

requests.problem: GetActiveObject attaches ROT-selected Excel before PID check; read-only provider calls can have side effects. N1 cannot assert guaranteed no state change.
requests.proposal: Do not run v1 as-is. Review exact-instance binding or separately approved UIA-only human-context protocol, revalidate PID/session/context before and after, record provider read risks, and replace unconditional NoWorkbookWrite claim with measured/unknown state-change evidence in a new version.
requests.acceptance: N0 mocked wrong-ROT/PID reuse/context race/provider-effect tests; actual N1 only after authentic exact permission/mitigation/context proof. No edits to v1 in C07.
